name: presentations
description: Real deck production: a widescreen PPTX, a PDF pitch, a diagram and an SVG.

commands.name: deck
commands.template: Create one widescreen PPTX for: {input}. Pass the topic. When a slide count is named, pass that many slide objects, each with a title, a claim and at most four points. Put the user's figures in source_notes. Then verify the printed path and run qa on it.

commands.name: outline
commands.template: Build a slide-by-slide outline for: {input}. Name the audience, the thesis and one claim per slide. Leave the file unwritten.

commands.name: notes
commands.description: Write speaker notes for a deck
commands.template: Write a speaker_note for each slide about: {input}. Pass the notes on the slide objects. They are stored in the deck spec. Read that spec and quote one note per slide. The pptx file has no notes page.

tools.name: create_pptx_deck
tools.description: Creates a native, editable enterprise pitch deck as .pptx with real text boxes, shapes, scorecard and claim-spine manifest. Use this when the user asks for PowerPoint, PPTX, editable slides or Fortune-500/board-level presentations.

thesis.description: Core thesis or claim the deck argues.

slides.description: Optional: slide outline as a list of {{title, claim, body, visual, proof}} or markdown sections.

filename.description: Optional output file name (a bare name, not a path); the result line names the finished file.

deck_profile.description: Deck profile: product-platform, engineering-platform, strategy-leadership, gtm-growth, finance-ir, or consumer-retail.

design_theme.description: Visual theme: evergreen, executive, or studio.

source_notes.description: What the deck is based on: user-provided facts, files, assumptions, or missing evidence.

evidence_level.description: How strongly the deck is grounded in evidence.

enterprise_grade.description: When true, applies Fortune-500/board-level scoring and anti-amateur constraints.

template_path.description: Optional absolute or ~-relative path to a .pptx template to base the deck on.

brand_name.description: Brand name shown on the slides.

deck_quality_profile.description: Quality profile for Deck Engine v2; enterprise is the local default.

source_notebook_path.description: Optional absolute or ~-relative path to a local Source Notebook used for evidence-grounded deck generation.

asset_paths.description: Optional absolute or ~-relative paths to local image/logo/brand assets. Missing assets are surfaced as Studio warnings.

tools.name: create_pitch_deck
tools.description: Creates a high-end 16:9 pitch deck as quality-checked PDF slides plus an optional animated HTML preview. The result names the finished files. Use this for investor decks, sales decks, product pitches and presentation-ready slides.

thesis.description: Core thesis or claim the deck argues.

slides.description: Optional: slide outline as a list of {{title, claim, body, visual}} or markdown sections.

filename.description: Optional output file name (a bare name, not a path); the result line names the finished file.

include_animation_preview.description: When true, also renders an animated HTML preview of the deck.

deck_profile.description: Deck profile: product-platform, engineering-platform, strategy-leadership, gtm-growth, finance-ir, or consumer-retail.

design_theme.description: Visual theme: evergreen, executive, or studio.

source_notes.description: What the deck is based on: user-provided facts, files, assumptions, or missing evidence.

evidence_level.description: How strongly the deck is grounded in evidence.

enterprise_grade.description: When true, applies Fortune-500/board-level scoring and anti-amateur constraints.

deck_quality_profile.description: Quality profile for Deck Engine v2; enterprise is the local default.

brand_kit.description: Optional local brand kit object with brand_name, primary, and secondary fields.

source_notebook_path.description: Optional absolute or ~-relative path to a local Source Notebook used for evidence-grounded deck generation.

asset_paths.description: Optional absolute or ~-relative paths to local image/logo/brand assets. Missing assets are surfaced as Studio warnings.

tools.name: edit_pptx_template
tools.description: Copies an existing PPTX and replaces text runs in-place to preserve the template layout and styles.

template_path.description: Absolute or ~-relative path to the source .pptx that is copied and edited.

replacements.description: Mapping old_text -> new_text or list of {{from,to}}.

filename.description: Optional output file name (a bare name, not a path); the result line names the finished file.

tools.name: inspect_pptx_template
tools.description: Analyses a local PPTX file as a template: slides, editable text runs, palette, sample texts and warnings.

path.description: Absolute or ~-relative path to the .pptx file to analyse.

filename.description: Optional output file name (a bare name, not a path); the result line names the finished file.

tools.name: qa_pptx_deck
tools.description: Creates a local PPTX QA report and HTML contact sheet for visual review of the slide structure.

pptx_path.description: Absolute or ~-relative path to the .pptx deck to QA.

tools.name: create_diagram
tools.description: Creates a professional SVG diagram in Ephe design. kind: 'mindmap' | 'timeline' | 'flowchart'. items: list of points, optionally 'Label | Description' per point. Use this for mind maps, timelines/roadmaps and process/flow diagrams. theme='dark' (default) is the studio surface; theme='light' is the print palette for embedding in a PDF with a whole line ![diagram](/absolute/path.svg).

kind.description: Diagram kind: one of mindmap, timeline, flowchart.

title.description: Title shown as the heading (also the file-name base).

items.description: Points as JSON array or rows in the format 'Label | Description'

filename.description: Optional output file name (a bare name, not a path); the result line names the finished file.

tools.name: create_svg
tools.description: Saves SVG graphics code as a .svg file. You write the SVG code yourself. The result names the finished file. For logos, icons, diagrams.

svg_code.description: The SVG source code to save.

filename.description: Optional output file name (a bare name, not a path); the result line names the finished file.

changelog: 1.2.0 - the deck tools ask the host. The slide text, the notes and the path stay out of the bridge row. The skill prompt carries an output contract and a quality gate. 1.1.0 - DoD pass: skill pack with two examples, commands, changelog and README entry.
